eng.traineddata.gz: English model for Tesseract OCR, as packaged in @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
(the 4.0.0_best_int build). Unchanged from the package.

Where it comes from: Google's tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best models, repackaged by the Tesseract.js
project (naptha/tessdata). Both of those repositories are released under the Apache License 2.0;
the full text is in LICENSE in this folder. The npm package's own metadata lists "MIT" but ships no
licence text, so the Apache text from the data's source is the one included here.

https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tesseract.js-data/eng
